rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
Welcome back! Today’s skill is about how you and your spouse can set an example for your children by creating respect at home. 💙 

Family and friends might have their own ideas about how you should act as a spouse or a parent.❗

But what matters most is how both husband and wife choose to talk to and support each other, and make decisions together and respectfully. 🔄
rows.text_2::eng: Treating each other with respect and making decisions together can have a big impact on how you feel and can help keep your child feel safe. 💚😃

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Think about working as a team! Try this.
rows.quiz_1_question::eng: True or False: Important decisions that impact the whole family or the relationship should only be made by one spouse.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

🔑 When making big decisions that impact the whole family or relationship, it is important for spouses to practise making decisions together.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng:
🎉 You are right! 

🔑 Communicating and making big decisions together with our spouse is an important part of having a respectful relationship.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Let’s observe how couples can value each other’s opinions and make decisions together:
rows.character_1_text::eng: My dear, you look worried. What’s wrong?
The stove has not been working very well recently. I think the stove might be broken.
rows.character_2_text::eng: I noticed this too when I was cooking last week. I wanted to ask you: do you think we should buy a new one?

rows.character_1_text::eng: Buying a new one would be really expensive. How about we talk about it after dinner, and we can make a decision together?
rows.character_2_text::eng: That sounds great. Thank you for cooking dinner, my dear!

rows.character_1_text::eng: I am grateful we can talk about this and make this decision together. It makes a lot more sense to try to get it repaired first.
rows.character_2_text::eng: Me too. I feel a lot better now that we have talked about it together.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: 4️⃣ Here are four simple steps that you and your spouse can use to create respect at home for your children to learn from:

rows.section_1_text::eng:
💡 Involve your spouse in decision making processes.
💙 Try this the next time you are making a decision.
rows.section_2_text::eng:
😃 It can be hard to know how to involve your spouse when making a decision. 
✨ You can try by asking them what they think. 
💚 This shows them you care and want them to be involved.
rows.section_3_text::eng: ⏰ Choose a time when you and your spouse are not too busy to discuss decisions, such as early in the morning or later in the evening.
rows.section_4_text::eng:
⏰ It can take time to get used to making decisions together. 
🔄 Give yourself time and keep trying! 
😃 By communicating with your spouse, you’ll both feel more comfortable talking and sharing decisions over time.

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Your home activity for today is to involve your spouse in a decision you are making today. Can you do it? ⏰⭐
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng: Well done! Communicating and working together with your spouse makes a difference! 🎉
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng:
It can take time to get used to making decisions together. Give yourself time to adjust. ⏰

Remember that by communicating with your spouse and involving them in decision-making, they will start to feel more comfortable doing so too. ⭐
